slice: W269 context-owned declared Compact JSON writer

claim.adversary: ROBUST within the finite context-bound JSON witness, exact affected cohorts, semantic staged readback and fresh prior byte/native guards. Broader recursive MRK3 body framing remains OPEN with a verified refusal guard, not capability closure.
claim.scope: One sorted-UInt64-key part with six parent rows, three two-row marks plus EOF. Explicit immutable contexts bind five independent static Object sites in root JSON, Array(JSON), Array(Tuple(JSON, UInt8)) and Tuple(JSON, JSON). Native profile: Object V3 wire 4, Dynamic V3 wire 4, typed id UInt64 and label String, max_dynamic_paths=2/max_dynamic_types=1, MAP with one bucket or MAP_WITH_BUCKETS with two, String0, LZ4, BASIC/COMPACT Variant discriminators, plain MRK3/MRK4. First-prefix statistics are supplied sample authority. Late shared values, ordinary Bool/String/UInt64 arms and zero-child marks are measured.
not_claimed: Every recursively admitted descriptor, typed/actual arm, site owner, bucket count or serializer profile is native-qualified
Typed-Dynamic Array(UInt8) under nonempty Array(JSON) has a working MRK3 physical body-owner handler
Dynamic-owned JSON sites, advanced/chunked SharedData layouts, String1 writer or compressed marks
All Object/Dynamic serialization versions are native-qualified; V1/V2 later-prefix checks are local
Arbitrary keys/partition metadata, incremental append, arbitrary static/context-owned interleavings or Compact MV/projection composition
Replacement of prior separately qualified Wide/metadata MV/projections, or all-type reader/writer parity
Stock MRK3 capture, identical compressed bytes/frames, whole-part statistical recomputation or a W269 unsealed mutant control
Granule-only local I/O, outside-window corruption locality, single preparation or zero allocation
Combined-executable/full-suite/self-contained fresh-clone qualification, large-part scale, RSS, allocation-order experiment or <=10% speed parity
Latest upstream/all ClickHouse versions or identical source/runtime revisions
claim.evidence_policy: Curated index to executed commands and root-dereferenced primary/raw evidence. Field presence, shape validation and model agreement are not substantive proof. Native CHECK is structural/checksum evidence, distinct from literal SELECT.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: persistent recursive Object/Dynamic serialization, per-granule callback placement, explicit context authority and staged publication
boundaries.rollback: Revert only the atomic W269 feature; preserve user-owned W263 specs, original captures and frozen previous byte/native oracles.

protected_check.property: All three paths retain the exact protected SHA256 values and remain outside staging.

boundaries.authority: Scoped local implementation, disposable native test stores, exact-path atomic local commit only. No push, original-capture mutation, unrelated staging, history rewrite or full-goal complete update.

resource_guard.execution: Root-only serial compiler/native execution; unchanged guards.

laws: Reuse ISerialization substream/callback grammar; Compact physical callback scheduling differs from Wide file envelopes.
Object and Dynamic structure/statistics prefixes remain version-owned. Object V3 and Dynamic V3 wire values are 4, not Native-only FLATTENED wire value 3.
First-block sample structure/statistics is write authority; per-granule body values and later empty/absent prefix statistics are distinct.
MAP and MAP_WITH_BUCKETS have distinct callback rosters; advanced saved coordinates require relocation and are not discarded.
Source checkout and native executable are separately pinned revisions; no latest-version claim follows.

design.public_input: CompactPartColumn.json(name, schema, granules, context) carries StorageColumnValue inputs with explicit ObjectDocumentPlan authority.
design.context_owner: Own-file CompactJsonWriteContext snapshots the exact static-site map and required first-prefix statistics; detached context/input state prevents caller replacement from changing planned output.
design.callback_owner: Own-file CompactJsonCallbackPlan reuses recursive occurrence grids and source-aligned logical-role/physical-callback association; exact prefix/body order and cumulative operation budget are checked.
design.encoded_column_owner: Own-file CompactJsonEncodedColumn reuses ObjectDocumentCodec, structure prefix codecs and ObjectDocumentColumnWriter.inline_raw_layout_at_child_site; unresolved relocation sidecars refuse.
design.assembler_owner: Existing Compact static physical backend remains the sole assembler for data.bin, LZ4, granule/column/callback offsets, plain MRK3/MRK4, EOF, metadata and checksums.
design.staging_owner: Own-file CompactJsonPartReadbackValidator and CompactPartValueComparison compare complete Object paths/nested values, not scalar byte length or BinaryValue object identity. Missing Nothing/NULL and retained typed NULL keep separate contracts.
design.narrow_framer_change: CompactJsonObjectMapTapeFramer learns root.data Bool/UInt64 widths; common recursive decoder owns semantics. Other unsupported body owners still refuse before publication.

source_state.seal_method: Sorted relative path, NUL, per-file SHA256, newline; SHA256 of the concatenation. Production is src/**/*.cr; source/spec/script includes src/**/*.cr, spec/**/*.cr and every regular file under scripts. Documentation is outside these pools.
source_state.note: The qualified source state is anchored by baseline plus exact changed-file pins, even though qualification ran before the atomic commit. Packet excludes its own hash.
